description: A sticky global navigation bar with mega-menu panels, search and bag actions, above a sample product hero.
overview: A sticky top navigation bar with mega-menu panels, a brand link and search and bag buttons, shown above a sample hero. The bar is translucent and blurred, turns solid while a panel is open, and collapses into a full-screen menu on mobile or whenever the links don't fit. Built on the `Navbar` pattern, it suits sites with a deep catalog or many sections.
usage: Edit `items`: plain entries take a label and `href`, and mega-menu entries take `columns`, each with a label, an optional featured flag and a list of links. Replace the brand link and hash URLs, and give the search and bag buttons handlers. Remove the sample hero below the bar.
notes: The hero image is an Unsplash placeholder.
